evidence.quote: if conditions continue to evolve in the direction traveled thus far, then additional cuts will be appropriate.
if progress on inflation continues as I expect, I will support additional cuts in the federal funds rate going forward.
consistent with ongoing progress toward the FOMC's 2 percent target.
In summary, after a period of demand exceeding supply, the labor market appears to have rebalanced.
we should now also shift attention to the maximum-employment side of the FOMC's dual mandate.
while avoiding unnecessary pain and weakness in the economy as disinflation continues in the right trajectory.

parsed.rationale: The speaker strongly supports the 50 bp cut and explicitly signals that further cuts are appropriate, citing ongoing disinflation and a cooling labor market. The emphasis shifts toward the employment side of the mandate and avoiding unnecessary weakness, which is clearly dovish.
